next.reason: 1985: 'identifier-2 [ ROUNDED ] … [ ON SIZE ERROR imperative-statement-1 ] [ NOT ON SIZE ERROR imperative-statement-2 ]'; 2023: 'identifier-2 [ rounded-phrase ]; ROUNDED [ MODE IS {AWAY-FROM-ZERO … TRUNCATION} ]; size-error phrases in choice indicators, any order'. 2023 accepts more programs: ROUNDED MODE IS options, and NOT ON SIZE ERROR may precede ON SIZE ERROR. 1985 had bare ROUNDED and a fixed phrase order.
